mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past three months signals an active monetary easing cycle, reducing discount rates on future corporate earnings and increasing the present value of equities, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive in periods when FEDFUNDS declines, with a t-test p-value > 0.05 or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate above 10.0% over the past month signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which increases the probability of a recession and triggers risk-off behavior, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 10.0%, or the Rank IC is negative over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in both housing starts and real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) signals weakening aggregate demand, which reduces corporate revenue expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict negative SPX returns over 60 days in more than 60% of cases, or the interaction term's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in industrial production below 98.0 for two consecutive months indicates a contraction in real economic output, which increases the likelihood of earnings downgrades and triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when INDPRO remains below 98.0 for two months, with t-test p > 0.05 or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) combined with rising housing starts (HOUST) signals strong aggregate demand, which boosts corporate earnings expectations and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint rise in RSAFS and HOUST fails to predict positive SPX returns over 5 days in more than 60% of cases, or the interaction term's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the CPI inflation rate above 2.0% over the past three months signals persistent inflationary pressure, increasing the likelihood of future monetary tightening, which raises discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative when CPIAUCSL exceeds 2.0% YoY, with t-test p > 0.05 or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in non-farm payroll growth below 50,000 jobs per month, combined with a rising unemployment rate, signals labor market weakness, which reduces consumer spending and corporate confidence, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of PAYEMS < 50k and UNRATE > 10.0% fails to predict negative SPX returns in more than 60% of cases, or the interaction term's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real GDP (GDPC1) over the past four quarters indicates a contraction in aggregate demand, which increases the probability of recession and triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative when GDPC1 declines over four consecutive quarters, with t-test p > 0.05 or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.
